geometry.locator: NuMI Facility TDR (FERMILAB-DESIGN-1998-01) Appendix A, beam sheet 'Site coordinates for beamline: horn2.ces' (DUSAF x, y in ft; station along the beam in ft)

method: Published coordinates converted to WGS 84: the beam sheet rows HALTA (target), DECAY and DENCU (start and end of the decay pipe), DUMP (absorber), MUON0 and MUOND (muon alcove region), M ENCU (upstream end of the MINOS enclosure), MIN_NO (MINOS near detector) and ROCK (downstream end), joined by straight segments; every row is collinear within 0.01 deg (bearing 152.18332 deg ccw from site east, pitch -3.336 deg). Conversion of DUSAF to WGS 84: DUSAF x, y (ft) are the FSCS coordinates of Beams-doc-1148 (origin A0 = 41°50′14.312704″ N, 88°15′41.143123″ W, false x = y = 100000 ft, +y axis at geodetic azimuth 38°16′48.01429″, scale 1.000029251 at A0), applied as a rotated tangent plane on the GRS80 ellipsoid (difference to the double stereographic projection below 0.2 m within 1.5 km of A0). NAD83 and WGS 84 are taken as equal. Replaces the earlier derived straight line (accuracy 30 m).
name: NuMI neutrino beam centreline, target to MINOS hall
notes: Beam points at the Soudan laboratory (MINOS far detector, 1985-2016 era) at bearing 336.17 deg; NOvA at Ash River is 0.6 deg away (see geometry:fermilab-numi-direction).

summary.plain: The straight line the NuMI neutrino beam follows underground, from the target to the MINOS near-detector hall, about 1 km long.
